title: sigelo/0 bundle
description: What an identity presents (SPEC §8). Unsigned; every element carries its own signature. genesis is the ORIGINAL genesis; all four arrays are required and may be empty. This schema is the part whose malformation is fatal (SPEC §9 step 2): the bundle's own shape, genesis, every rotation envelope and every issuers entry. attestations and bindings need only be arrays here: a verifier checks each item against attestation-envelope.json or binding-envelope.json and discards (and counts) one that fails, while the rest still verify — so a bundle carrying a junk item is still a valid bundle (the bundle vector carries two). The SPEC §3 number and string rules still apply to every item: a float or a lone surrogate in one discards that item.

bindings.description: Items: binding-envelope.json, checked per item (a failing item is discarded, not fatal).

attestations.description: Items: attestation-envelope.json, checked per item (a failing item is discarded, not fatal).
